Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Party food status
- Added an optional Well Fed marker beside party members, with a configurable warning threshold and remaining-time tooltip.
- Live status updates once per second only while out of combat inside an instance.
- Added /foodcheck to print each party member's remaining Well Fed time in system chat.

Party cooldowns
- Default now asks before restoring the selected side's layout and every job's default ability list and one-row layout.
- The other side's placement and live cooldown timers are preserved.

Death information
- Enemy damage-downs active at death now appear in summaries even when they are missing from the captured killing-hit snapshot.
- Enemy mitigation icons keep their border and identify the source on hover when available.
